title: nan
authors: Lee I.; Sung C.-K.; Lee H.; Nam S.; Oh J.; Lee K.; Park C.
key_contribution: Presents a georeferenced UAV localization framework using scene matching with orthorectified aerial imagery and EKF sensor fusion for GNSS-denied mountainous terrain, validated in flight tests.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
